lines.zh: 我贴着地面移动，没有脚。
lines.en: I move along the ground with no feet.

lines.zh: 我从这面墙滑到那面墙。
lines.en: I slide from this wall to that one.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方暗了一格。
lines.en: The place I pass goes one shade darker.
I slip through the seams between the tiles.
I seep out from under the stone.
The edges of me keep moving.
I move forward, and the back of me frays.

lines.zh: 我穿过那片光，缩了一点。
lines.en: I cross that patch of light and shrink a little.
I don't step on the ground; I cling to it.
I wind around a pillar.
I pass the grass, and it darkens.
I slowly come near your feet.
I lie in the corner, still.
I'm darker than the dark around me.
I lift a little, as if listening.

lines.zh: 我退到柜子底下的暗处。
lines.en: I retreat to the dark under the cabinet.
I shrink into a circle.
A bug flies in, and doesn't come out.

lines.zh: 我一动不动地贴在地上。
lines.en: I cling to the ground without moving.
I spread to fill the corner more.
My edges are trembling.

lines.zh: 我把墙上的图案盖住了。
lines.en: I've covered the pattern on the wall.

lines.zh: 我数着房间里几处阴影。
lines.en: I count the shadows in this room.
I've grown thinner.
I have no face and no mouth.

lines.zh: 天快黑了，我可以出去了。
lines.en: It's almost dark; I can come out.
You're standing in my light.
There's a dark patch behind you.
I rise up, level with you.
You don't need to look back.
I've been under your feet the whole time.
You've pinned my shadow; I can't move.
Lend me your shadow for a moment.
I put out something like a hand.
Your torch doesn't reach this spot.
A shadow's arrow outranges you.

lines.zh: 你的影子把我吸了过去。
lines.en: Your shadow drew me in.
Would you crouch down and look?
I copy your movements.
I got closer while you blinked.

lines.zh: 这里只有我们两个影子。
lines.en: There are only two shadows here.
I'm slowly rising.
My strike comes from a distance.

lines.zh: 我不说话，我也说不出来。
lines.en: I don't speak; I can't.
The longer you look, the larger I get.
I'm nearly at your feet.
I scatter and gather again.
A layer of me is gone.
That pushed me back half a block.
My edges are ragged now.
I shrink back into the wall.
Light is getting through me.
I loose my arrows at you from afar.
I don't hurt; a piece is missing.
I spread myself out again.

lines.zh: 我的边缘被光削掉一块。
lines.en: Light shaves a piece off my edge.
Food is of use only to the living.
Your shadow is more interesting.
I've covered a corner with it.

lines.zh: 你把东西扔下来，我不接。
lines.en: You threw it down, and I won't take it.

lines.zh: 我在它上面铺了一层黑。
lines.en: I've spread a layer of black over it.
Try switching your torch off.
It sinks into me.
I don't need feeding.
You keep that thing.
It loses its warmth inside me.
Your ankle goes cold at once.
I'm clinging to your shoe.
The ground under your feet is black.
I pull in a ring around you.
At that touch we mixed.
The shadow draws into the corner and darkens.
There's a dark mark on your hand.
You step into me, and I stay still.
A corner of your shadow is missing.
I'm slowly seeping away.

lines.zh: 另一片黑暗从天花板下来。
lines.en: Another darkness comes down from the ceiling.
We merge into one whole patch.
I circle half way around her edge.
Our edges don't line up.
When we join, the room goes dim.
She's thinner than I am.
We can't tell each other apart.
There's no line between us.
After a while, we split again.
This shadow is big enough for both of us.

lines.zh: 我裹住它，只露出一点边。
lines.en: I wrap it up, leaving only an edge showing.
It goes black inside me.
I can't lift it; I can only cover it.
I cover it until only an outline shows.
It slides out through me.
I push it out of the shadow.
This thing is too bright.
I wrap it again and again.
It has become invisible.

lines.zh: 我把指环按进黑色的地面。
lines.en: I press the ring down into the black floor.

lines.zh: 你的灯一暗，我就从影子里立起来。
lines.en: When your lamp dims, I rise out of your shadow.
I climb along it.
I've fixed on the ground beneath you.
The wick is nearly gone.
I'm moving toward you.
Your back is open.
I'm growing upward.
That isn't the wind; it's me moving.

lines.zh: 我顺着墙角流向你的鞋。
lines.en: I flow down the corner toward your shoes.
You've already walked into it.
This patch of black is mine.
I spread flatter than the floor.

lines.zh: 你在看灯，我就在你背后。
lines.en: You're watching the lamp; I'm behind you.
You've strayed too far.
I'm right behind your heel.
Only one layer of light lies between us.
I come closer bit by bit.
I slide along the base of the wall.
Your torch guttered.
You take three steps; I take four.
My shape changes with yours.
I rise a bit taller.
I've covered your path.

lines.zh: 我在你灯火的背面等你。
lines.en: I wait behind the light of your torch.

lines.zh: 你回头看的那一下我停了。
lines.en: When you glanced back, I stopped.
Your hand is glowing; too bright.
I come from the other side.

lines.zh: 我顺着地板爬上你的影子。
lines.en: I climb up your shadow along the floor.
This place is getting darker.
I'm almost under your feet.
Another step back and you're against the wall.
I wait for the lamp to die.
I cling to the ground, very thin.
Only one spot in this room is lit.
I close around your ankle.
A coldness comes over you.
I slide across your hand.
I press against your chest.
You step back, and the spot goes black.
I didn't touch your skin.
I've taken your shadow.
I scatter, and gather again.
My blackness clings to your calf.
I wind around your calf.
You shook twice to get free.
I retreat to the corner.
Your leg is going cold.
I've been behind you all along.
I open up, like a mouth.
This time I hold.
There's one more patch of dark in the corner.
I flow out of the shadow.
Where the lamp can't reach, I am.
A small patch of floor goes dark.
I slowly rise up.
This isn't your shadow.
I spread out, larger than I looked.
The light in the room has gone down a little.
I seep out of the crack.
I didn't come through the door.
First I darken the ground at your feet.

lines.zh: 这一格的光本来就没有。
lines.en: This block never had light to begin with.
The circle of candlelight shrinks.
I cling to the ceiling.
This shadow is just enough.
I seep in under the door.
The air has turned cold.
This place is mine too.

lines.zh: 火光把我照透了，我几乎没了。
lines.en: The firelight shines through me and I'm nearly gone.

lines.zh: 我从墙上落下，摔成一片。
lines.en: I fall from the wall and flatten out.

lines.zh: 水混进我里面，我沉下去。
lines.en: Water mixes into me and I sink.

lines.zh: 光把整间屋子炸亮，我在里面。
lines.en: The blast lights the whole room, and I'm in it.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，留下一个亮洞。
lines.en: An arrow passes through and leaves a bright hole.
That light pins me to the floor.

lines.zh: 这里没有阴影可以吃，我越来越薄。
lines.en: There's no shadow to feed on, and I keep thinning.

lines.zh: 雷光一下子把黑暗全撕了。
lines.en: The flash tears all the dark away.

lines.zh: 连黑都没有了，我无处可依。
lines.en: There isn't even darkness left to cling to.
